title: Venn diagram template
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y3 lesson 8 (Venn diagram template (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 8: Similarities and differences. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Alike and different
points: We all need food, sleep, kindness
We differ in languages, likes, skills
Both are part of Allah's plan

blocks.title: Sort into: Everyone shares this / This can be different
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Everyone shares this, This can be different.
blocks.answer: Everyone shares this: Needing water; Needing kindness; Feeling sad sometimes. This can be different: Favourite food; Language at home; Hobbies

blocks.h: Venn diagram: me and my partner

box.title: Three sentences. Start: 'Our class is better because ...'

keywords.def: being mindful of Allah; what makes a person best with Him

questions.q: Fill the Venn diagram for you and a partner: two things in common, two different.
questions.a: For example: both like football; one speaks Urdu, one Somali.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: write three sentences about a difference that makes our class better. Start: 'Our class is better because ...'
questions.a: For example: 'Our class is better because we speak many languages and can teach each other words.'

questions.q: Extend: find out how to say 'peace be upon you' in another language a classmate speaks.
According to 49:13, who is best in the sight of Allah?
options: The one with the most taqwa
questions.a: A) The one with the most taqwa. 49:13: the most noble is the most righteous.

questions.q: Allah made us into peoples and tribes so we can ...
Think again: If you could only be friends with people exactly like you, what would you miss out on?
questions.a: New ideas, skills, foods, languages and stories. Differences help us learn from each other.
